h: Atiku's camp hits back at Shettima over remarks about his Kano School of Hygiene training
p: Supporters of ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar have reportedly responded to Vice President Kashim Shettima's mockery of Atiku's early schooling, turning the argument on President Tinubu's own academic record. The APC has not yet answered the counter-claim.
more: The exchange follows Shettima's separate criticism of Peter Obi earlier today.
Education records have been a recurring theme of the 2027 campaign.
